entities.summary: Prince Jan Duklan Maurycy Paweł Puzyna de Kosielsko was a Polish Catholic Cardinal who was auxiliary bishop of Lwów from 1886 to 1895, and the bishop of Kraków from 1895 until his death in 1911. Named a Cardinal in 1901, he was known for his conservative views and authoritarianism.
